title: Single-channel overnight sleep staging
current_best_explanation: No current global winner has been verified on this exact frozen input, split and scorer. A published dataset name or broad leaderboard lead is insufficient.
executed_endpoint: SleepEDF first eight first-night subjects, five train/three test; fixed 20:00–08:00 interval, 1440 30-second epochs/night, 100 Hz Fpz-Cz only, five R&K-derived classes, macro-F1. Wake retained by wall clock rather than label trimming.

existing_reference.name: Training-night spectral/statistical gradient boosting and pretrained YASA
existing_reference.strength: YASA is a practical EEG-only specialist with usable pretrained staging.
problems: Not proof of current best sleep staging.
External pretraining and optional clinical channels/demographics must be disclosed.
Very small custom night selection differs from SleepEDF20/78 literature.
existing_reference.verification_scope: Only the named locally audited reference/archived outputs, not every newer candidate or equal-budget/global optimality.

candidates.name: SleepGPT
candidates.evidence: B: peer-reviewed channel-adaptive model, single-channel experiments and author code.
candidates.information_match: Most promising new EEG-only candidate; Fpz-Cz adaptation, 100 Hz conversion, full-night head and corpus overlap need explicit verification.

candidates.name: SleepFM-Clinical
candidates.information_match: Multimodal native model; use only a documented missing-channel/EEG-only configuration, never fabricated EOG/ECG.

candidates.name: SleepFM-2
candidates.evidence: C: recent preprint, exact executable single-channel artifacts not verified.
candidates.information_match: Wearable transfer is relevant but does not certify this five-stage Fpz-Cz protocol.

candidates.name: PFTSleep
candidates.evidence: B: published full-night model; weights on request.
candidates.information_match: Multichannel design and missing public weights limit immediate matched use.

candidates.name: U-Sleep
candidates.information_match: Its EEG+EOG interface does not directly match this EEG-only slice; a documented ablation is required.

candidates.name: BIOT / LaBraM EEG-only probes
candidates.information_match: Direct single-channel candidates; unrelated published splits and metrics cannot decide this slice.

recommended_next_comparator: SleepGPT single-channel staging with a fixed train-night head, alongside unchanged YASA; SleepFM-Clinical only if its released model supports the actual single-channel input.
switching_assessment: ADD a current pretrained specialist arm, high priority, Tier B. Do not erase YASA or call SleepFM-2 an executable best model until checkpoint, pretraining provenance and single-channel interface are verified. Declare external-data and GPU budgets.
limitations: Three held-out nights/people provide weak population evidence.
Full 12-hour wake distribution changes macro-F1 versus sleep-period trimming.
Pretraining on SleepEDF or its target recordings must be excluded or labeled exposed.
PFTSleep article states weights on request.
SleepFM-2 executable availability not established by this bounded check.

evidence_tiers.A: Locally executed and audited on this frozen protocol; establishes a comparator result, not universal optimality.
evidence_tiers.B: Primary method/benchmark with relevant task evidence but an unmatched split, inputs, scorer or budget.
evidence_tiers.C: Author repository, preprint, mathematical proposal or adaptation requiring additional validation.
evidence_tiers.D: Unresolved access, unavailable artifacts or input mismatch precludes an executable recommendation.

execution_policy: Literature review only. No inference, fitting, new scores, checkpoint downloads, frozen protocol edits or result changes. Any new comparator requires a prospective amendment, frozen training-only selection and separate result records.
score_import_policy: No unmatched published numbers were imported into benchmark scores.
